verses.1: And these priests and Levites who went with Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, were Yeshua Shraiya Yirmiya Ezarah.
verses.3: Shekhnyah is filled with compassion and mercy.
verses.5: From the right side of Ma’adia in Belga.
verses.6: Hear and know what others say.
verses.7: Sallu Amok Khilkiya knew these leaders of the priests and their families during the time of Yeshua.
verses.8: And the Halviyim were saved through the intercession of Kadmiel, Shrebyah, Yehuda, Matanya, and their brothers.
verses.9: And in Kvukya and Uni, their children stood against them to protect them.
verses.10: And He will give birth to sons, and these sons will give birth to Eliyashiv. And Eliyashiv will give birth to Yo’yada.
verses.11: And Yod’a will know Yonatan, and Yonatan will know Yadu’a.
verses.12: And in the days of Joakim, there were priests who were leaders among the daughters of Abohad. They were Meria, Jeremia, and Hananiah.
verses.13: May Ezerah be a blessing to Amariah Yehohanan.
verses.14: Yonatan will reign over Shevania. Yosef.
verses.15: For the sake of honor, let us divide them into parts.
verses.16: In his memory, let them be remembered forever.
verses.17: To Avia, I remember the days of Minyamin and Mo’ada Piltay.
verses.18: To Belgium, may it be a reminder for Shmaiah Yehonatan.
verses.19: And Loiyarib gave me knowledge of Uzi’s secrets.
verses.20: To Salai Kalai for his people.
verses.21: To divide it into parts, to understand its nature.
verses.22: The blessings in the days of Eliaši’b, Yoaydan and Yochanan; they know what is written in the records of the ancestors and priests regarding the reign of Daryo’sh the Persian.
verses.23: The sons of Levi are listed as heads of their families, according to the register of the days from the time of Jonathan son of Eliashib.
verses.24: And the leaders of the Levites considered Shearion and Yeshua, sons of Cadmon. They also had their own priests who served them, following the commands of David, the man of God. He was a man who was chosen to be a priest.
verses.25: Matanya and Bakukya are servants who carry out the orders of Talamon. They guard the treasures in the gates.
verses.26: These are the days of Yoikim, son of Yeshua, son of Yozadak. And these are also the days of Nehemiah the scribe and Ezra the priest.
verses.27: And in the streets of Jerusalem, they asked for people from all over to come to Jerusalem, so that they could celebrate and rejoice there. They also sang songs of joy and praise.
verses.28: And the sons of the rulers and from the courts around Jerusalem, as well as from the palaces of Netophtha, gathered together.
verses.29: And from the houses of Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for they built their courtyards around Jerusalem.
verses.30: And the priests and Levites cleansed themselves. They also cleaned out the people, the gates, and the houses.
verses.31: And I will raise the wings of the Jews above their bodies. Two great torches will be placed on their right sides, above their bodies, at the door of the burning house.
verses.32: And after them went Oshaya and half of the priests of Judah.
verses.35: And from the descendants of the priests, in the chambers of Zekarya, there were: Yonatan’s son, Shemaiah’s son, Matanyah’s son, Mikhaya’s son, Zekur’s son, and Asaf’s son.
verses.36: And his brothers: Shemaiah and Azariah. They spoke evil of me. Maimanel and Yehuda also spoke evil of me. Hanani was one of the singers of David’s songs. He was a man of God. And Ezer was the scribe who wrote these songs for them.
verses.37: And on the gate of the eye, opposite them, they climbed up onto the heights of the city of David. From there, they went up to the house of David, and all the way to the gate of the water.
verses.38: And the second journey to Moab… I will follow behind her. Half of the people will go up to the mountains, and then to the wide plain.
verses.39: And from above the gate of Efrém, and from above the gate of Yeshana, and from above the gate of Dagon. From above the hill of Hananel and from above the hill of Me’ah, all the way to the gate of Tzohn. They stood at the gate of Matara.
verses.40: And the two doors stood in the Temple of God. I and half of the scribes were with me.
verses.41: And the priests Elaykim are those who perform rituals related to Minyamin Mikhaya. They are Eloyeinah, Zekharyah, and Hananyah. They work in the courts.
verses.42: And their actions, their voices, Elazar, Uzi, Yehohanan, Malchiyah, Eilam, and Azer… The scribes heard them. And the messenger will shine brightly.
verses.43: On that day, they offered great sacrifices. They were very happy because God was pleased with them. Even the women and children were happy. The joy in Jerusalem could be heard from afar.
verses.44: And on that day, men were assigned tasks related to the preparation of sacrifices for the Lord. They were also responsible for preparing utensils for the offerings that would be offered in the cities according to the laws of the Torah. This was done by the priests and Levites. It was a time of joy for the Jews, as they celebrated with the priests and Levites who stood there.
verses.45: And they shall keep the laws and regulations related to holiness, as well as the rules regarding cleanliness and hygiene. This is in accordance with the laws set by David Solomon.
verses.46: In the days of David, the leaders of the people gathered together to sing hymns and praises to God.
verses.47: And all of Israel, in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, offered sacrifices and offerings every day. They also sanctified the offerings for the priests, and the priests sanctified them for the sons of Aaron.
